nurse.text: Fàilte to Portree Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. We're the only building on the quay that hasn't got a fishing boat painted on it.
What can we do for you?

then.text: In you come out of the wind. We've the heating on, the kettle on, and the biscuits out. We're a full set.
All done. Tapadh leibh, that's 'thank you', and mind the slippery bit on the quay. It's always slippery. It's the whole quay.
The Ark terminal. It's connected to the harbour office, so if it beeps, check the tide.

else.text: No worries. Come back when you're ready. The weather, as usual, will have changed twice.
